children: have launched the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a coalition advancing data centers that can manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.

The alliance aims to make AI data centers more flexible power consumers by allowing them to shift computing workloads, use energy storage, and reduce electricity demand during periods of grid stress. The approach could help accelerate connections for new AI infrastructure while making better use of existing grid capacity.
Nvidia and Emerald AI are already working with energy and infrastructure leaders on AI factories that can respond to grid conditions in real time.
AEMA will broaden that work by bringing the technology, energy, and policy communities together around models that can be deployed across the U.S.

title: Nvidia, Google, Emerald AI launch alliance to make AI data centers grid-friendly
